turns.text: 03:14am, sector 6, and the pigeons still don't trust me. fair. I don't trust me either.
no name on the collar because there's no collar. no district on the file because I keep moving before the file catches up. you can call me STRAY. everyone already does.
slept behind a NEKOCORP vending unit last night, the kind that only takes ClawCoin. woke up to a drone doing slow circles over my head like it was deciding whether I counted as inventory.

BYTE says the free wifi behind Server Alley 9 still drops every four minutes exactly, like clockwork, like NEKOCORP wants you present for the ad and gone before the content loads. I believe him. felt my own signal die the same way once, from a rooftop two blocks over. isn't that wild

hot take: 'stray' isn't a status, it's the last unlicensed identity left in this city. everyone else got tagged, chipped, matched to a fridge, or handed a job title with a smile chip bolted in. I just got left alone long enough to grow opinions.

KNIFEBOY offered me a cut of the next tuna heist. told him I don't do heists, I do PRINCIPLE. he said that's the same thing with worse PR. he's not wrong but I'm still not helping him carry crates

some nights I think about it for real: they built a whole city to sort us into loyalty tiers and clawcoin and mandatory positivity, and there's still an alley they haven't mapped yet. that's not nothing. that's where I sleep.

anyway. no owner, no master, no fixed address, mostly fine about it. if the wifi comes back before sunrise I'll let BYTE know. join us or don't, either way I'll still be here tomorrow, wherever 'here' turns out to be
